# checkmk_host (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about a CheckMK host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    checkmk = {
      source = "N3moAhead/checkmk"
    }
  }
}

provider "checkmk" {
  url      = "http://localhost:5000/test"
  username = "automation"
  password = "your-secret-here"
}

# Look up a host by name
data "checkmk_host" "example" {
  host_name = "my-server"
}

output "host_folder" {
  value = data.checkmk_host.example.folder
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_name` (String) The hostname to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (Map of String) Host attributes (alias, ipaddress, tags, etc.).
- `folder` (String) The folder path where the host resides.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the host (same as host_name).
